description:
## [0.0.18](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/compare/v0.0.17...v0.0.18) (2026-10-31)

### Features

* **Instagram:** `Stop videos looping` is a new patch under Playback. Feed videos and reels stop on their last frame instead of playing again. Reels still loop while auto scroll is on, so it can move on. It starts off. Asked for in #248 and #175.
* **Instagram:** `Hide Subscribe on profiles` and `Hide the arrow at the end of the buttons` are new under Profiles. The other buttons fill the row, and the arrow's menu goes with it. Both start off. Asked for in #248.
* **Instagram:** `Skip the contacts and location popups` is a new patch. With its switch on under Ads and privacy, the screens asking you to sync contacts and turn on location stop opening at every start. It starts off. Asked for in #295, #329 and #421.
* **Instagram:** `Emoji style` gets `Emoji pack` under Layout. Keep your phone's emoji, download Twemoji, OpenMoji or Blobmoji, or pick a color emoji font, then restart Instagram. A pack only switches in once its download checks out. Asked for in #166.
* **Instagram:** `Smooth story opening` is a new patch under Stories. A story you tap in the stories row zooms open more slowly and stops without the little bounce at the end, and it closes the same way. It starts off. Asked for in #409.
* **Instagram:** `App-only proxy` is a new patch under Ads and privacy. Type an HTTP proxy's address and port in `Proxy server`, restart, and only Instagram goes through it. It takes plain HTTP proxies that need no password. Starts off. Asked for in #219.
* **Instagram:** `Copy text button on reels` and `Copy text button on stories` add a Lens icon that opens Google Lens on the reel or story to copy its words. Without the Google app it opens the share sheet. Both start off. Asked for in #303.
* **Instagram:** `Ambient light in stories` is a new switch under Stories. A story that doesn't fill the screen gets a soft glow in its own colors in the black bands, and it changes with each photo or video. Starts off. Asked for in #420.
* **Instagram:** `Ambient light` is a new patch under Feed, off to start. Posts in Home and Following glow softly in their own colors, and so do the bands around a reel that doesn't fill the screen. Asked for in #416.
* **Instagram:** `Carousel arrows` is a new patch. Its switch under Feed puts a back and a next arrow on a carousel post, so a tap moves to the next photo or video without swiping. It starts off. Asked for in #417.
* **Instagram:** `Carousel arrows` gets `Page dots on a pill`, a new switch right under the arrows. A carousel's page dots move onto a round pill at the bottom, with your page in blue. Starts off. Asked for in #419.
* **Instagram:** `Keep Home's top bar` gets `See-through top bar`, a new switch right under it. Home's top bar turns to frosted glass and your posts show through it as they scroll, whether the bar stays or slides away. Needs a restart. Asked for in #418.
* **Instagram:** `Hide ads` now hides the ad that shows up among a post's or reel's comments too. Asked for in #415.
* **Instagram:** In `Stop Reels scrolling`, `Stop after 20 reels` is now `Stop after a set number of reels`. Sliders pick the count (5 to 100) and how long Instagram sits in the background before swiping works again (5 to 120 minutes). Asked for in #405.
* **Instagram:** `Keep a viewing history` under Ads and privacy keeps a list of the posts, reels, stories and profiles you looked at, on this phone only. `Clear viewing history` empties it. Starts off. Asked for in #228.
* **Instagram:** The `App icon` list now shows each choice's real icon in its own colors next to its name, with the one in use marked, so you can see what you're picking before you leave Instagram. Asked for in #321 and #327.
* **Instagram:** The `Accent color` list on Android 11 and older marks the color in use again.
* **Instagram:** On Android 11 and older, `Material You` now stays in the `Color` list, greyed out, with the reason on it. Before, it just wasn't there. Asked for in #187 and #264.
* **Instagram:** `Clean up Reels` adds `Start every reel in clear mode` under `Keep clear mode on`, so reels open in clear mode with no tap. Instagram blocks screenshots there unless `Allow screenshots` is on. Starts off. Asked for in #138.
* **Instagram:** `Icons in the accent color` is a new switch under `Accent color`, off to start. After a restart the top bar, profile, tab bar and post icons take your color. Text keeps its own. Asked for in #8.
* **Instagram:** `Explore without personalization` is a new patch for the EU, where Instagram offers that grid. One switch under Explore opens it every time. Another hides its menu button. Both start off. Asked for in #311.
* **Instagram:** `Keep Featured off the heart's dot` under Notifications stops a Featured item from lighting the red dot on the heart. Likes, comments and follows still do. Starts off. Asked for in #189.
* **Instagram:** `Pinned chats` under Messages pins the chat you opened last to the top of your inbox. Pins stay on this phone, per account, and the same row unpins them. Asked for in #345.
* **Instagram:** `App icon` adds Hand-drawn Instagram, a pencil sketch of Instagram's glyph on white. Themed icons show the same sketch. Asked for in #406.
* **Instagram:** `Chat history tools` is a new patch. Its switch under Messages lets you long press a chat's name to jump to its first message or a date, loading older messages with a count and Cancel. Starts off. Asked for in #246.
* **Instagram:** `Chat history tools` gets a second switch, `Export a chat as text`. Long press a chat's name and pick Export chat to save the whole chat to Downloads/HushGram, one line per message. Starts off. Asked for in #247.
* **Instagram:** `Save comment photo` gets a second switch under Comments, `Reply with a comment's GIF`. A comment's menu gets a row that sends its GIF back as your reply, animated. Starts off. Asked for in #402.
* **Instagram:** `Use the highest refresh rate` is a new patch. Its switch, under Layout, asks Android to run Instagram at your screen's fastest refresh rate at the same resolution. It takes effect the moment you flip it, no restart. Starts off. Asked for in #401.
* **Instagram:** `Read messages without the seen receipt` gets a switch, `Mark a chat seen when you reply`. Replying lets that person see you read their earlier messages. Chats you don't answer stay unseen. Starts off. Reported in #365.
* **Instagram:** `Hide captions` is a new patch. Its switch, under Feed, takes the caption off feed posts and reels and leaves the post. The comments sheet still shows it. Off to start. Asked for in #395.
* **Instagram:** `Keep Home's top bar` is a new patch. Its switch under Feed keeps the Instagram logo and its buttons at the top of Home while you scroll. Restart Instagram after you flip it. Starts off. Asked for in #408, #367 and #223.
* **Instagram:** `Keep the Reels top bar` is a new patch. Its switch, under Reels, keeps the Reels title, the Friends tab and the buttons beside them at the top while you swipe through reels. No restart needed. Starts off. Asked for in #411.
* **Instagram:** `Mark one-time photos and videos` is a new patch. Its switch, under Messages, puts a border and Instagram's view once icon on one-time photos and videos in a chat. Only the look changes. Starts off. Asked for in #165.
* **Instagram:** `Pinch to zoom on Reels` is a new patch. Its switch, `Pinch to zoom` under Reels, lets two fingers zoom into a playing reel the way a photo zooms, and it goes back when you lift them. Starts off. Asked for in #382.
* **Instagram:** `HushGram settings` adds `Descriptions behind an info button` under Settings entry. It shows each switch by name alone, with a small i to tap for what it does. Off to start. Asked for in #130.
* **Instagram:** `Swipe through a chat's reels` adds `Stop after the chat's reels` under Messages, which ends reels you open from a chat at the last one shared there. No suggested reels follow. Starts off. Asked for in #390.
* **Instagram:** In `Download any video`, Copy media link under Details now says the link stops working after a few days, since Instagram's file addresses expire. Asked for in #364.
* **Instagram:** `Download any video` adds `Never save AV1 video` under Downloads, for a phone that plays AV1 badly. A video Instagram has at full size only as AV1 is saved as VP9, or at its largest H.264 size. Starts off. Asked for in #379 and #348.
* **Instagram:** `Download any video` adds `Never save HDR video` under Downloads. An HDR-only video is saved at its largest standard size instead, so it skips the yellow or green cast some apps give HDR. Starts off. Reported in #352.
* **Instagram:** `Seek bar on feed videos` is a new patch. A bar along the bottom of the video playing in your feed lets you drag to any point in it. The switch is under Feed and starts off. Asked for in #389.
* **Instagram:** In `Glass tab bar`, `Blur strength` and `Tab bar opacity` under Tab bar are sliders (2 to 48 dp, 0 to 150 percent), and the pill follows as you drag. Both start at the old look. Older backups still restore. Asked for in #391.
* **Instagram:** When Instagram crashes in the first minute after it opens, HushGram now keeps what crashed, and the diagnostics report you save from `HushGram settings` includes it. Turn on Debug logging to keep later crashes too.
* **Instagram:** `Group Instagram's notifications` adds `Mute notification types` under Notifications. It stops the types you tick, like the betting and promo pushes Instagram's own notification settings can't turn off, and works with grouping off. Nothing's muted to start.
* **Instagram:** `Lock your messages` adds `Fingerprint or face only` to Unlock with under Messages, on Android 11 and up. Its prompt has no PIN, pattern or password. Remove every fingerprint and face and your screen lock unlocks again.
* **Instagram:** `Full screen Reels and Home` adds `Show the whole reel` under Reels. Every reel fits inside the screen with black bars where its shape differs, so nothing's cut off at the sides. Starts off.
* **Instagram:** `Skip the collections tray` is a new patch. With its switch on under Feed, saving a post or reel shows Instagram's Saved message instead of the tray that asks you to start a collection. Starts off.
* **Instagram:** `Hide the Reels tab` adds `Settings button on Home's header` under Tab bar. A gear at the top of Home opens HushGram settings with one tap. Starts off. Asked for in #404.
* **Instagram:** `Download any story` adds `Download button on stories` under Stories. A button at the top of a story, beside the three dots, saves the photo or video in front with one tap. Starts off. Asked for in #400.
* **Instagram:** `Start reels with sound` adds `Start reels muted` under Playback. Every reel starts silent, even from a link or a notification, and the volume keys or speaker icon unmute it. Starts off. Asked for in #342.
* **Instagram:** `View live anonymously` adds `Mark as seen button on lives` under Stories. While you watch a live anonymously, an eye beside the three dots puts you on that live's viewer list when you tap it. Starts off. Asked for in #412.
* **Instagram:** `Glass tab bar` adds `Bend light at the edges` under Tab bar. With `Liquid glass look` on, the pill's rim bends what passes under it the way real glass does, on Android 13 and up. Starts off. Asked for in #369.
* **Instagram:** `Glass tab bar` adds `Run Reels behind the tab bar` under Tab bar. The reel fills the screen behind the pill, with its caption, buttons and seek bar just above it. Starts off. Asked for in #372.
* **Instagram:** `Clean up Reels` adds `Hide suggested searches on reels`, `Hide shopping buttons on reels` and `Hide poll prompts on reels` under Reels. Each takes its prompt away from beside the reel's author. All three start off. Asked for in #332.
* **Instagram:** `Start Home on Following` adds `Fall back to Following` under Feed. When For you brings an account only suggested posts, page after page, Home opens on Following for that account. A feed you pick stays picked. Starts off. Asked for in #308.

### Bug Fixes

* **Instagram:** `Instagram logo on Home` works without `Start Home on Following` now. Turned on, the logo stays put as you scroll instead of switching to "Home" and flashing blank in between. Reported in #413.
* **Instagram:** `Turn off HDR brightness boosts` also stops the brighter white Instagram 452 and later give some reels on phones with HDR headroom, like the Galaxy S25 FE. Reported in #85 and #26.
* **Instagram:** `Full size covers` asks for covers up to 1440 pixels wide now. It used to stop at 1080, and some picked covers are 1290 wide. Reported in #214.
* **Instagram:** Turning `Full size covers` on or off now reaches reels you'd already opened. Instagram keeps the cover sizes it was sent across restarts, so the first start after a change now drops those saved answers. Reported in #214.
* **Instagram:** `Hide Featured in notifications` works on Instagram 453 again, Threads suggestions included. Featured rows were back at the top of Notifications. Reported in #259.
* **Instagram:** With `Hide the Muse card`, the Meet Muse card stays off Home and your profile when Instagram sends it some other way. It still showed up now and then. Reported in #294.
* **Instagram:** With `Pure black dark mode`, a story now opens straight on black. It flashed Instagram's dark blue for a moment first. Reported in #360.
* **Instagram:** With `Pure black dark mode`, the screen Instagram shows while it starts up is black in dark mode too. It stayed dark gray. Reported in #410.
* **Instagram:** With `Gray out stories you've watched`, your own `Your story` now stays first in the tray, ahead of the watched stories pushed to the back. Before, it could end up among them. Reported in #241.
* **Instagram:** With `Pure black dark mode`, HushGram's own settings cards and dialogs are black now. They stayed dark gray. Reported in #374.
* **Instagram:** With `Glass tab bar` and `Hide the tab bar on Reels`, a reel fills the screen again once the pill slides away. It left a black band where the pill had been. Reported in #335.
* **Instagram:** A save that comes out in lower quality because your phone's storage is low now says so in its toast, and a carousel's summary counts how many. It used to blame only Instagram's quality. Reported in #348.
* **Instagram:** With `Tab bar layout`, picking Classic or Swipe under Tab bar works on Instagram 453 again. On 0.0.17 it changed nothing, since the patch was answering an Instagram setting the tab bar never reads. Reported in #356.
* **Instagram:** With `Tab bar layout`, a long press on the classic bar's Search tab opens search with the keyboard up again. Instagram 453 waited for pages only the swipe bar has, so the press just switched to Explore. Reported in #383.
* **Instagram:** `Full screen Reels and Home` makes room for the status bar on a profile again. With `Full screen Reels` on, going back from a reel you'd opened there left the person's name behind the clock. Reported in #385.
* **Instagram:** Typing fast in the `HushGram settings` search keeps every letter. The list used to take the focus from the field while it filtered, so a letter could go missing or come out twice.
* **Instagram:** With `Gray out stories you've watched` on in `View stories anonymously`, a story you've just watched keeps its place in the tray until you pull down to refresh. It used to jump right the moment you closed it. Reported in #377.
* **Instagram:** On Instagram 453, `See who a story mentions` puts its pill just under the story's header, lined up with the name. In the name row it pushed the name up into the progress bars. Reported in #405.
* **Instagram:** With Hide shopping on in `Hide suggested posts`, Explore no longer leaves blank squares where a shop tile was. A shop tile inside a bigger block now takes the whole block out, so the grid closes up. Reported in #393.
* **Instagram:** `Show all recent searches` now lists every recent search on accounts where Instagram builds the search screen the newer way. Those still stopped at five. Reported in #375.
* **Instagram:** `Swipe through a chat's reels` makes a second tap on a post or reel in a chat wait for the first to open. On a slow phone each extra tap opened another copy. Reported in #390.
* **Instagram:** With `Logo and titles at the start` and `Hide Create on Home's header` both on, Instagram's logo no longer touches the screen's left edge. It keeps the gap the heart has on the other side. Reported in #407.
* **Instagram:** With the `Glass tab bar` pill floating, coming back to Reels from a reel's profile no longer lays the Reels screens out again. That second layout could leave the video stuck on its cover while the sound kept playing. Reported in #378.
* **Instagram:** `See who a story mentions` no longer cuts the account's name short. When the name's row can't fit the pill, like on a highlight with a full date, the pill moves just under the header. Refs #405.
* **Tooling:** When patching for a phone stops on an Instagram build with no reviewed coverage, the message now names the builds that have it, so you know which one to patch.
* **Tooling:** Patching for a phone without `-Apk` takes the declared Instagram build from the fixture folder the way the release gate does, `.apks` bundles included. It used to skip `.apks` and take any file with the version in its name.
* **Tooling:** The whole-app walk takes one more look, after a short pause, at a settings heading it caught mid-animation. It used to call the heading missing and fail the walk when a section was still opening or folding.
* **Tooling:** When a settings heading isn't there, the whole-app walk says so as soon as the list stops moving. It used to keep swiping up past the top of the list, 24 times each way.
* **Tooling:** Patch results, records and the patch catalog are read as strict JSON. A file that names a field twice could read as a pass and a failure at once, so it's refused.
* **Tooling:** The release notes check refuses a bullet scoped to a patch name in any section after 0.0.17, Unreleased included, so each bullet names its patch in the text. It used to pass any dated section.
* **Tooling:** The native runner reads the user limit the way Android 17 prints it, "Maximum supported switchable users", so it runs on an API 37 emulator. It used to stop there, saying the device takes one user.
* **Tooling:** The release check reads an index description naming only the Instagram build as the published release's facts, still under that version's heading. A retarget held at the published version used to fail every push.
* **Tooling:** The release check holds a published receipt to the coverage census its own commit reviewed. Once a retarget replaced the old build's entry, the shipped receipt read as uncertified and the check failed on every push.
* **Tooling:** The source audit reports a source it couldn't read past a rate limit as unread, and fails GitLab code search when a limit keeps a hit's project unread. Both used to be treated as gone.
* **Tooling:** The source audit waits out a rate limit for as long as the forge's Retry-After asks, up to five minutes. A longer one, like GitLab's hourly limit, fails that source at once and says when it resets.
* **Tooling:** The source audit leaves a source unread when a rate limit stops a branch comparison, instead of reporting the branch as new work. A server error on a GitLab hit's project now fails the search too.

### Improvements

* **Instagram:** In Morphe Manager, `Ask before a like` and `Long press to zoom` now sit under Interaction beside `Change the like animation`, which keeps the Feed group short. Their switches are still on the Feed settings page.
* **Tooling:** Updated to Morphe patcher 2.1.0, so patching needs Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 1.20.0 or newer. The dependency audit now reviews Morphe Desktop 1.20.0.
* **Instagram:** `See who a story mentions` opens its list again when you come back from an account's profile, so you can go down the list without reopening it each time. Close ends it. Asked for in #403.
* **Instagram:** HushGram now patches Instagram 453.0.0.57.79 instead of 453.0.0.55.79. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480-640dpi) (Android 9.0+) variant, build 385914557. Its armeabi-v7a (385914556) and x86 (385914558) builds are declared too. Meta published no x86_64 build this time.
* **Instagram:** Manager lists `Keep a seek bar on Reels` under Playback now, next to `Seek bar on feed videos`, and the Reels group gets one row shorter. Its switch is still under Reels.
* **Instagram:** Manager lists `Start feed videos with sound` and `Keep the reel speed` under Playback now, out of the long Feed and Reels groups. Their switches haven't moved.
* **Instagram:** In `Download any reel`, Download audio's line in the diagnostics report says when a reel's only sound is xHE-AAC, which some players can't play. The file is still saved as it is, never re-encoded. A follow-up to #216.
* **Tooling:** The native runner has a share case for the share sheet stand-in. The share and its sender always come through. Instagram's links are the only ones cleaned, and just while `Sanitize sharing links` is on.

### Validation

Validation: 7862 runtime tests passed locally. All 2411 patch tests passed too.

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green, teal or your wallpaper's colors (Material You, on Android 12 and newer). Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you take screenshots and record your screen where Instagram normally blocks it, such as disappearing photos and videos in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Ambient light
patches.description: Puts a soft glow in a post's own colors around its photo or video in Home and Following, and in the bands around a reel that doesn't fill the screen. The glow follows a video as it plays, and you pick how far it spreads and how fast it changes. A second switch fills the bands above and below a story that doesn't fill the screen. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed and Stories.

patches.name: App-only proxy
patches.description: Sends Instagram through an HTTP proxy you set, without changing the proxy for other apps or the phone. You need to set a server too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Ask before a call
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on the call button doesn't ring anyone, and can take the call buttons off the top of a chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Ask before a like
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't do it for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Ask before a refresh
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so an accidental pull doesn't replace what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Back leaves Home
patches.description: Makes Back on Home leave Instagram at once, instead of first scrolling the feed to the top and reloading it or saying "Tap again to exit". Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Blur the bars around Reels
patches.description: Shows a blurred copy of a reel above and below it, or beside it, where Instagram would leave black bars. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Carousel arrows
patches.description: Puts a back and a next arrow on a post's carousel in Home and Following, so a tap moves to the next photo or video without a swipe, and can move its page dots onto a round pill over the photo. The pill can be solid, see-through or frosted glass. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Change the like animation
patches.description: Lets you pick the animation that plays when you double tap a post to like it. The choices are animations Instagram made for its Rings creators. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Change version code
patches.description: Stops Google Play from offering Meta's updates over your patched Instagram. Going back to the normal Instagram later means uninstalling first, which deletes its data. Later HushGram builds need this patch too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Chat history tools
patches.description: Tap the clock button at the top of a chat, or long press its name, to jump to its first message or to a date, or to save the chat as a text file. The chat loads its older messages on its own, with a count and a Cancel button. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Chat plus menu
patches.description: Lets you take Saved, AI images and Draw off the plus menu in a chat's message bar, and move the gallery and microphone buttons into that menu. Starts with every switch off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Clean up Reels
patches.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Save button, the Create and Your algorithm buttons, the Friends tab and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons while you aren't touching the screen. Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels, and can start every reel in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Clear the media cache
patches.description: Frees storage by deleting Instagram's saved copies of photos and videos once they pass 500 MB. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay. A row clears them right away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Storage.

patches.name: Control taps and volume on Reels
patches.description: Lets you choose what a single tap on a reel does: Instagram's default, pause, or mute. Can also keep a reel muted when you press volume up. Both start at Instagram's behavior. Choose them in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Copy comment
patches.description: Adds Copy and Copy username to the menu you get on a comment, so you can copy its text or the commenter's username. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Data saver
patches.description: Saves mobile data by loading smaller photos and starting videos at the lowest quality. It uses Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it turns both on. It starts with mobile data only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Default playback quality
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays. Nothing changes until you pick a quality. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Don't report Blend visits
patches.description: Stops Instagram from telling a chat that you opened its Blend. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Don't report screenshots
patches.description: Stops Instagram from telling people when you take a screenshot of their disappearing photo or video. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Don't save recent searches
patches.description: Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches.description: Stops Instagram from learning which reels you watched and how far you got. Reels you've already watched may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Download any reel
patches.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries, and Download audio saves just its sound. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. A separate switch under Downloads puts a download icon under Save beside each reel, and another adds a Lens icon for copying a reel's text. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Download any story
patches.description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. Videos save at the quality you choose and photos at their largest size, and Download as photo saves a still from a video story. A Download button at the top of a story is a separate switch, off to start, and so is a Copy text button that opens Google Lens on the story. Turn them on or off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Download any video
patches.description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover, a Details row with the post's time and poster, a download icon beside Save under each post, and Hold to download, which saves a post or reel you hold two fingers on. Download all waits its turn, with up to ten posts queued, so two posts' pages never mix in your gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Download voice messages
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu you get when you hold a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Emoji style
patches.description: Shows every emoji in Google's style instead of your phone's own, or in a free emoji pack (Twemoji, OpenMoji, Blobmoji) or a color emoji font file you pick. The full change shows after you restart Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Explore without personalization
patches.description: Opens Explore on the grid that isn't personalized every time and keeps it from switching back after ten minutes. Instagram only promises that grid in the EU. A second switch hides the EU menu button for it. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Find the reel you came from
patches.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. A photo reel is found in their posts. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap Find the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Font
patches.description: Lets you pick the font Instagram's text uses: Instagram's own, your phone's, or a .ttf or .otf file. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts on Instagram's font. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Full resolution photos
patches.description: Loads photos in the largest size Instagram sends instead of one picked for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on screens under 1440 pixels wide, and a third gets reel covers and grid pictures at full size. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Full screen Reels and Home
patches.description: Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally while Home or your messages do. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels (Full screen Reels), Feed (Full screen Home) and Messages (Full screen Messages).

patches.name: Glass in chats
patches.description: Gives a chat's top bar frosted glass that blurs the messages under it (Android 12 and newer) and puts the back, call and video buttons on round glass circles. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Glass tab bar
patches.description: Draws the tab bar as a floating, rounded pill of frosted glass that blurs what's behind it (Android 12 and newer), with a highlight on the tab you're on. Content can optionally run down behind it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Tab bar, then restart Instagram.

patches.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group for each type, so they don't fill your notification shade. Tapping one still opens it. You can also mute the types you pick, like promo pushes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Hide AI-labeled reels
patches.description: Leaves out reels that carry Instagram's own AI label. A reel without that label stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide Follow on feed posts
patches.description: Takes the Follow and Subscribe buttons off the top of posts in your feed. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide Follow on stories
patches.description: Takes the Follow button off the top of stories from accounts you don't follow. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide Instants
patches.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instants is Instagram's no-edit camera for sharing quick photos with friends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI
patches.description: Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet and feed. Each part has its own switch. The search one and the Meta AI posts one start on, the rest start off. Change them in HushGram settings > Meta AI.

patches.name: Hide Notes on profile pictures
patches.description: Takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, yours included. Notes in Messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches.description: Removes the rows of suggested reels from your home feed. A reel posted by someone you follow stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide activity bubbles
patches.description: Takes the little round pictures off posts and reels that show a friend liked, commented on or reshared them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Hides sponsored posts, reels, stories and the ad in comments, and leaves no gap where an ad would have been. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Hide captions
patches.description: Takes the caption off posts in your feed and off reels. The post stays, and the comments sheet still shows it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide comments
patches.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet
patches.description: Takes the New group button and the button that sends to several people as a group off the share sheet, and lets you pick which of the round buttons under the people it shows. You can still start a group from your messages. Both start off. Find them in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide highlights
patches.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts and posts stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide paid partnership Reels
patches.description: Leaves out reels with a Paid partnership label, and reels Instagram marks as boosted. Ads have their own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide profile tabs
patches.description: Lets you take the Reels, Reposts and Tagged tabs off profiles, yours and other people's, and keep the grid. Starts with every tab showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide reels by caption words
patches.description: Leaves out reels whose caption holds a word or phrase from your list, and Home's posts too with Also on Home. Starts off. Turn it on and type the words in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide reels with few views
patches.description: Leaves out reels in the Reels tab with fewer views or likes than numbers you pick. Accounts you follow stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide rows in Instagram's settings
patches.description: Lets you take the rows you don't use off Instagram's own Settings and activity screen. Open that screen once, then untick rows in HushGram settings > Layout > Rows in Instagram's settings. Every row shows to start.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts in DMs
patches.description: Takes the Accounts to follow section off the bottom of your messages. Your chats and follow requests stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts in Reels
patches.description: Leaves out the cards of accounts to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide suggested people on profiles
patches.description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles. Bios, counts and posts stay. More switches take Suggested for you off the follow lists, their Suggested tab and the Follow requests screen, the Complete your profile cards off your own profile, and People you don't follow back, suggested threads and people, and the Featured section off your notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide suggested posts
patches.description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide the 'Are you interested in this post?' question on Home and Reels, the caught up card, all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked or posts from accounts you pick. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one to that list, and those posts leave Home on the next refresh. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested stories
patches.description: Removes stories from accounts you don't follow from the row at the top of Home. More switches hide rewinds and memories, keep only verified or unverified accounts, or hide the whole row. Starts on. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide that you're typing
patches.description: Stops the people you're chatting with from seeing when you're typing. You still see when they type. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide the Explore grid
patches.description: Empties the grid of posts and reels on the Search tab. Search, recent searches and results stay. A second switch hides the suggested accounts that show when you tap the search bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. A second switch, Show the Reels tab, puts it back after Home when Instagram built your bar without one, and Hide wins if both are on. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels. Under Tab bar, switches do the same for Home, Search, Create, Messages and Profile, two put Messages or Activity on the bar when Instagram left them off, switches take the Create and notifications buttons off Home's header, others add a Search, Messages, Ghost mode or menu button to it or put Instagram's logo in its middle, two center the name at the top of profiles and the title on other screens, a list puts the tabs in your order, and another picks the tab Instagram opens on.

patches.name: Hide the Repost button
patches.description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide the Share button
patches.description: Takes the Share button and its count off posts in your feed and off reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide the Threads button
patches.description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles, with switches for the Create button and Share profile on your own, and Subscribe and the arrow after the buttons on creators' profiles. The menu and the other buttons stay. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide the audio icon on posts
patches.description: Takes the speaker icon off videos in your feed. Tapping the video still turns the sound on or off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide the comment emoji row
patches.description: Takes the row of quick emoji off above the comment box. The box itself stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide the home feed
patches.description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows only the stories row. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide the notes row
patches.description: Takes the row of notes, and the Map bubble in it, off the top of your messages. Your chats stay. A second switch takes only the Map bubble. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide the search bar in Messages
patches.description: Takes the search bar and its Filter button off the top of your messages, the Meta AI bar too. Your chats and notes stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide your active status
patches.description: Stops people from seeing Active now for you while you use Instagram. You still see when they're active. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Home header text
patches.description: Puts words of your own, or a picture, at the top of Home in place of Instagram's logo. Nothing changes until you set one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: HushGram launch screen
patches.description: Shows HushGram's logo instead of Instagram's on the screen you see while Instagram starts, on Android 13 and newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: HushGram settings
patches.description: Adds a HushGram settings page to Instagram. Open it by long-pressing the Instagram logo at the top of your feed or Instagram's icon, or from the top of Settings and activity. Turn features on or off there, pause HushGram and save diagnostics. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Install next to Instagram
patches.description: Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options, and whether its icon gets a HushGram badge. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: The second Instagram's package. Each part starts with a letter, with dots between the parts, and it can't be Instagram's own.
The name under the second Instagram's icon. It starts with a letter and holds up to 50 characters.
Puts a small HushGram badge on the second Instagram's home screen icon, so the two are easy to tell apart. Instagram's other icons you can pick in its settings get it too.

patches.name: Keep Home's top bar
patches.description: Keeps the Instagram logo and the buttons beside it at the top of Home while you scroll. A second switch shows your feed blurred under them. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches.description: Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. It can also move on to the next reel when one ends on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches.description: Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep in chat
patches.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Keep stories playing while zooming
patches.description: Keeps a story playing while you pinch to zoom it, instead of pausing it. A story you hold still first stays paused. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Keep the Reels top bar
patches.description: Keeps the Reels title, the Friends tab and the buttons beside them at the top while you swipe through reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep the reel speed
patches.description: Keeps the 2x speed on for the next reels after you lock a reel at 2x (hold its edge, then slide down), until you slide the lock off. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep your place in Home
patches.description: Coming back to Instagram leaves Home on the post you were on, however long you were away, instead of reloading it and jumping to the top. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Lock your messages
patches.description: Covers your inbox and chats, all of Instagram, or just the single chats you pick under Locked chats, until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. Message notifications only say that a message came. Chats you pick under Hidden chats leave your inbox and their notifications don't post. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Long press to zoom
patches.description: Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big around your finger, and let go to close it. Pinch to zoom still works. Keep the zoom open leaves it up after you let go, to drag and pinch from 1x to 4x until a tap or Back closes it. While its switch is on, it takes the place of Instagram's own long press on a photo. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Loop a story
patches.description: Plays a story again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Mark one-time photos and videos
patches.description: Puts a border and Instagram's own view once icon on a one-time photo or video in a chat, so you can tell it before you open it. Only how the chat looks changes. Nothing is saved, replayed, marked seen or sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Message box buttons
patches.description: Lets you take the gallery, sticker and voice message buttons off the message box of a chat, and keep the text box and Send. Starts with every button showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Open comments without the keyboard
patches.description: Comments open with the keyboard down. A tap in the comment box, or on Reply, still brings it up. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links you tap in your usual browser instead of Instagram's built-in one, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram pages and ads still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Phone layout on big screens
patches.description: On a foldable or tablet, Instagram keeps its phone layout across the whole screen, with the tab bar at the bottom instead of down the side. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Pick the app icon
patches.description: Lets you pick the icon Instagram shows on your home screen: Instagram's own, HushGram's, Instagram's glyph on black, on plum, or in black on white, a hand-drawn Instagram glyph on white, Instagram's gradient glyph on dark, the old retro camera icon, or Instagram's glyph in pink on pale pink. The new icon shows once you leave Instagram, and you may need to add it to your home screen again from the app drawer. Starts on Instagram's own. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Pinch to zoom on Reels
patches.description: Lets you zoom into a playing reel with two fingers, the way a photo zooms. Lift your fingers and it goes back. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Preview chats
patches.description: Long press a chat in your messages and tap Preview to read its newest messages without opening it, so nobody sees Seen. You can reply from there too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Profile posts as a list
patches.description: Opening someone's profile takes you on to their posts as a scrolling list of full posts. Back shows the grid. Your own profile keeps its grid. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Pure black dark mode
patches.description: Makes Instagram's dark mode pure black instead of dark gray, on the menus that slide up from the bottom too. It looks deeper and can save battery on an OLED screen. Buttons keep their grays so they stay easy to see. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Read messages without the seen receipt
patches.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you've seen their messages. You still see when they've seen yours. Mark as read, or the check mark at the top of a chat, still tells them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Remove build expired popup
patches.description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build can't update itself, so it would stop working after a few weeks. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Version warnings.

patches.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches.description: Stops Instagram from reading your phone's advertising ID, which ad companies use to follow you between apps. Instagram gets a string of zeros instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Remove the empty space at the bottom
patches.description: Takes away the empty gap Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches.description: Lets Instagram's own checks of who signed the app pass on a patched build, so the parts that need them keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key work too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Resume long videos
patches.description: A video or reel longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time you play it on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Rounded post corners
patches.description: Rounds the corners of a post's photo, video and carousel pages in Home and Following, and of reels and stories if you like, at a small or large size. Profiles and Explore stay as Instagram draws them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes tracking tags from the links you copy or share, and opens bio links without Instagram's click tracker. The link still opens the same post, reel, story or profile. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Save comment photo
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo or GIF, saving the largest size Instagram sent. A GIF is saved as a .gif in Pictures/Instagram, taken from Instagram's own copy, not Giphy. If Instagram lists only an animated WebP or an MP4 for it, you get that file instead, and an MP4 goes in Movies/Instagram like a video. It can also add a GIF reply to a comment with a GIF, sending that same GIF back as your reply. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Save profile picture
patches.description: Adds Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. View opens the picture full screen and lets you zoom. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Saved on your profile
patches.description: Adds a bookmark to the tabs on your own profile, beside posts, reels and tagged, that opens Saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles, then restart Instagram.

patches.name: See who a story mentions
patches.description: Adds a small label in a story's header showing how many accounts it mentions. Tap it for a list and tap an account to open their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Seek bar on feed videos
patches.description: Shows a bar along the bottom of the video playing in your feed that you can drag to jump to any point in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed. Another switch there adds a small button on the video that shows or hides the bar, and a choice under it makes the bar see-through or puts it on frosted glass.

patches.name: Seek bar on stories
patches.description: Shows a bar near the bottom of a video story that you can drag to jump to any point in the video. Photos don't get one. A choice under it makes the bar see-through or puts it on frosted glass. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Show a post's exact time
patches.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It does the same for comments. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Show a reel's exact time
patches.description: Adds the date and time a reel was posted under the author's name, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, with the seconds or how long ago (1d 2h 5m ago) if you want them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Show a story's exact time
patches.description: Shows the date and time a story was posted, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under the switch can show the time left instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Show all recent searches
patches.description: Lists every recent search under the search bar instead of the first few. See all and the x on each row work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Show hidden like counts
patches.description: Shows how many likes a post or reel has when its owner hid the count, as long as Instagram's server still sends the number. If it doesn't, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back, and Recent unfollowers shows who left your Followers list, with a Follower history of who left, came back or is new. The chip is blue for Follows you, green for Following each other and red for Doesn't follow you, and it can go small under the profile picture. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Show when someone was last active
patches.description: Shows the exact time someone was last on, like Active at 3:42 PM, in your messages and in a chat, instead of Active 3h ago. Active now stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Skip the ad data reminder
patches.description: Stops Instagram's reminder to review whether it can process your data for ads from opening by itself. Your ad choice doesn't change and nothing is answered for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Skip the collections tray
patches.description: Saving a post or reel shows Instagram's Saved message instead of the tray that asks you to start a collection. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Skip the contacts and location popups
patches.description: Stops the screens asking you to sync your contacts and turn on location services from opening each time Instagram starts. Nothing else is skipped. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Smooth story opening
patches.description: Opens a story from the stories row with a slower, gentler zoom instead of Instagram's quick spring. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Speed button on stories
patches.description: Puts a speed button at the top of a video story. Tap it to play the story at 1.5x or 2x, and later video stories keep that speed. Photos and ads play as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Spoof location
patches.description: Tells Instagram your phone is at a place you pick, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places. You need to pick a place too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Start Home on Following
patches.description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow instead of For you. A second switch removes For you from Home, and a third keeps Instagram's logo at the top of Home in place of the feed's name. A fourth, Fall back to Following, opens Home on Following for an account whose For you brings only suggested posts, unless you picked a feed. A fifth, Mix in Following, shows a page of posts from accounts you follow after each page of For you. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Start feed videos with sound
patches.description: Starts the first video on Home with its sound on, the same as tapping the video's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Start on x86 devices
patches.description: Stops Instagram from crashing or freezing on x86 devices that run its code through a translator, such as some Chromebooks and emulators. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Start reels with sound
patches.description: A reel you open from a post on Home plays with sound, and Home is muted again when you go back. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. A separate switch, Start reels muted, starts every reel silent instead. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Start stories with sound
patches.description: Opens stories with their sound on, the same as tapping Instagram's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop Reels scrolling
patches.description: Stops a swipe in Reels from moving to the next reel, so you stay on the one you opened. A second switch stops swiping after as many reels as you pick, for as long as you pick, and Take a scroll break covers Home, Reels and Explore for 5 minutes after the time you pick. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop background wake-ups
patches.description: Stops two alarms that wake your phone while Instagram is in the background. One goes off every minute or two only to note that Instagram is still running, and the other wakes it five minutes later to upload usage events. Messages and notifications still arrive. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Battery.

patches.name: Stop swipe to create
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera. The + button still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Stop swipe up to reply
patches.description: Stops a swipe up on someone's story from opening the reply box and its reactions. Tapping Send message still replies. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop swiping between tabs
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Stop videos looping
patches.description: Feed videos and reels stop at their last frame instead of playing again. Reels still loop while auto scroll is on, so it can move on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Stories priority
patches.description: Puts the accounts on your list first in the stories row at the top of Home while they have a story you haven't watched. Starts off. Turn it on and type the accounts in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Story ring size
patches.description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on screen, or larger, and the ring of a story you haven't watched in a color you pick. Nothing changes until you pick a size or a color. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Story text fonts
patches.description: Adds fonts you pick from your phone (.ttf or .otf files) to the story text editor alongside Instagram's own fonts, and can draw the emoji in story text from an emoji font file you pick. Starts off. Set both up in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Swipe left to open the profile
patches.description: Makes a left swipe on a reel open the profile of the person who posted it, like Instagram used to. Tap Friends at the top to reach your friends' reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Swipe through a chat's reels
patches.description: Swiping up on a reel you opened from a chat goes through the other reels shared in that chat before any suggested reels, can stop after them and can leave out the ones you sent. All start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Tab bar layout
patches.description: Lets you keep the newer tab bar, where you swipe between every tab, or the classic one, instead of the one Instagram picks for your account. Starts on Instagram's choice. Pick one in HushGram settings > Tab bar.

patches.name: Tap a feed video to pause it
patches.description: A tap on the video playing in a feed pauses it in place instead of opening it in Reels, and another tap plays it again. Ads keep Instagram's own tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Tap to play
patches.description: Makes videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, like Instagram does when it saves mobile data. A choice under the switch can leave Reels out or hold only Reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Thicker story progress bar
patches.description: Draws the progress bar along the top of a story twice or three times as thick. Its segments and timing stay as they were. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Turn off HDR brightness boosts
patches.description: Stops HDR photos and reels from making the screen brighter than everything else. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a post or reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. The Like button still works. Separate switches cover posts, reels, comments and chat messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Upload stories at full quality
patches.description: Sends the video stories you post at 1080p and a higher bitrate, as Instagram does with its own Upload at highest quality setting on. Two choices under it can cover posts and reels too and ask for a bitrate up to 50 Mbps. Instagram still shrinks story videos to 720p on its servers, so viewers see a small difference. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Use the highest refresh rate
patches.description: Asks Android to run Instagram at your screen's fastest refresh rate, at the same resolution, so scrolling looks smoother on a 90 or 120 Hz phone. Some phones keep their own limit for apps. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: View DM photos and videos anonymously
patches.description: Holds back the Opened notice for view once photos and videos in messages, so the sender doesn't see you opened them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: View live anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. Your own lives still count their viewers. An optional eye button at the top of a live puts you on that one's list. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch. Replying or reacting still shows you. An optional Mark as seen button lets you choose. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

release_notes:
HushGram moves to Instagram 453.0.0.57.79 and Morphe patcher 2.1.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer. Feed videos and reels can stop looping, feed videos get a seek bar, and a reel can show its whole picture with black bars instead of being cut off. Carousels can have arrows, chats can be pinned or exported as text, and a viewing history can stay on your phone. Among the fixes, `Tab bar layout` and `Hide Featured in notifications` work on Instagram 453 again, and `Pure black dark mode` now reaches the startup screen and HushGram's own settings.

New in this release

- `Stop videos looping` is a new patch under Playback. Feed videos and reels stop on their last frame instead of playing again. Reels still loop while auto scroll is on, so it can move on. It starts off. Asked for in #248 and #175.

- `Hide Subscribe on profiles` and `Hide the arrow at the end of the buttons` are new under Profiles. The other buttons fill the row, and the arrow's menu goes with it. Both start off. Asked for in #248.

- `Skip the contacts and location popups` is a new patch. With its switch on under Ads and privacy, the screens asking you to sync contacts and turn on location stop opening at every start. It starts off. Asked for in #295, #329 and #421.

- `Emoji style` gets `Emoji pack` under Layout. Keep your phone's emoji, download Twemoji, OpenMoji or Blobmoji, or pick a color emoji font, then restart Instagram. A pack only switches in once its download checks out. Asked for in #166.

- `Smooth story opening` is a new patch under Stories. A story you tap in the stories row zooms open more slowly and stops without the little bounce at the end, and it closes the same way. It starts off. Asked for in #409.

- `App-only proxy` is a new patch under Ads and privacy. Type an HTTP proxy's address and port in `Proxy server`, restart, and only Instagram goes through it. It takes plain HTTP proxies that need no password. Starts off. Asked for in #219.

- `Copy text button on reels` and `Copy text button on stories` add a Lens icon that opens Google Lens on the reel or story to copy its words. Without the Google app it opens the share sheet. Both start off. Asked for in #303.

- `Ambient light in stories` is a new switch under Stories. A story that doesn't fill the screen gets a soft glow in its own colors in the black bands, and it changes with each photo or video. Starts off. Asked for in #420.

- `Ambient light` is a new patch under Feed, off to start. Posts in Home and Following glow softly in their own colors, and so do the bands around a reel that doesn't fill the screen. Asked for in #416.

- `Carousel arrows` is a new patch. Its switch under Feed puts a back and a next arrow on a carousel post, so a tap moves to the next photo or video without swiping. It starts off. Asked for in #417.

- `Carousel arrows` gets `Page dots on a pill`, a new switch right under the arrows. A carousel's page dots move onto a round pill at the bottom, with your page in blue. Starts off. Asked for in #419.

- `Keep Home's top bar` gets `See-through top bar`, a new switch right under it. Home's top bar turns to frosted glass and your posts show through it as they scroll, whether the bar stays or slides away. Needs a restart. Asked for in #418.

- `Hide ads` now hides the ad that shows up among a post's or reel's comments too. Asked for in #415.

- In `Stop Reels scrolling`, `Stop after 20 reels` is now `Stop after a set number of reels`. Sliders pick the count (5 to 100) and how long Instagram sits in the background before swiping works again (5 to 120 minutes). Asked for in #405.

- `Keep a viewing history` under Ads and privacy keeps a list of the posts, reels, stories and profiles you looked at, on this phone only. `Clear viewing history` empties it. Starts off. Asked for in #228.

- The `App icon` list now shows each choice's real icon in its own colors next to its name, with the one in use marked, so you can see what you're picking before you leave Instagram. Asked for in #321 and #327.

- The `Accent color` list on Android 11 and older marks the color in use again.

- On Android 11 and older, `Material You` now stays in the `Color` list, greyed out, with the reason on it. Before, it just wasn't there. Asked for in #187 and #264.

- `Clean up Reels` adds `Start every reel in clear mode` under `Keep clear mode on`, so reels open in clear mode with no tap. Instagram blocks screenshots there unless `Allow screenshots` is on. Starts off. Asked for in #138.

- `Icons in the accent color` is a new switch under `Accent color`, off to start. After a restart the top bar, profile, tab bar and post icons take your color. Text keeps its own. Asked for in #8.

- `Explore without personalization` is a new patch for the EU, where Instagram offers that grid. One switch under Explore opens it every time. Another hides its menu button. Both start off. Asked for in #311.

- `Keep Featured off the heart's dot` under Notifications stops a Featured item from lighting the red dot on the heart. Likes, comments and follows still do. Starts off. Asked for in #189.

- `Pinned chats` under Messages pins the chat you opened last to the top of your inbox. Pins stay on this phone, per account, and the same row unpins them. Asked for in #345.

- `App icon` adds Hand-drawn Instagram, a pencil sketch of Instagram's glyph on white. Themed icons show the same sketch. Asked for in #406.

- `Chat history tools` is a new patch. Its switch under Messages lets you long press a chat's name to jump to its first message or a date, loading older messages with a count and Cancel. Starts off. Asked for in #246.

- `Chat history tools` gets a second switch, `Export a chat as text`. Long press a chat's name and pick Export chat to save the whole chat to Downloads/HushGram, one line per message. Starts off. Asked for in #247.

- `Save comment photo` gets a second switch under Comments, `Reply with a comment's GIF`. A comment's menu gets a row that sends its GIF back as your reply, animated. Starts off. Asked for in #402.

- `Use the highest refresh rate` is a new patch. Its switch, under Layout, asks Android to run Instagram at your screen's fastest refresh rate at the same resolution. It takes effect the moment you flip it, no restart. Starts off. Asked for in #401.

- `Read messages without the seen receipt` gets a switch, `Mark a chat seen when you reply`. Replying lets that person see you read their earlier messages. Chats you don't answer stay unseen. Starts off. Reported in #365.

- `Hide captions` is a new patch. Its switch, under Feed, takes the caption off feed posts and reels and leaves the post. The comments sheet still shows it. Off to start. Asked for in #395.

- `Keep Home's top bar` is a new patch. Its switch under Feed keeps the Instagram logo and its buttons at the top of Home while you scroll. Restart Instagram after you flip it. Starts off. Asked for in #408, #367 and #223.

- `Keep the Reels top bar` is a new patch. Its switch, under Reels, keeps the Reels title, the Friends tab and the buttons beside them at the top while you swipe through reels. No restart needed. Starts off. Asked for in #411.

- `Mark one-time photos and videos` is a new patch. Its switch, under Messages, puts a border and Instagram's view once icon on one-time photos and videos in a chat. Only the look changes. Starts off. Asked for in #165.

- `Pinch to zoom on Reels` is a new patch. Its switch, `Pinch to zoom` under Reels, lets two fingers zoom into a playing reel the way a photo zooms, and it goes back when you lift them. Starts off. Asked for in #382.

- `HushGram settings` adds `Descriptions behind an info button` under Settings entry. It shows each switch by name alone, with a small i to tap for what it does. Off to start. Asked for in #130.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels` adds `Stop after the chat's reels` under Messages, which ends reels you open from a chat at the last one shared there. No suggested reels follow. Starts off. Asked for in #390.

- In `Download any video`, Copy media link under Details now says the link stops working after a few days, since Instagram's file addresses expire. Asked for in #364.

- `Download any video` adds `Never save AV1 video` under Downloads, for a phone that plays AV1 badly. A video Instagram has at full size only as AV1 is saved as VP9, or at its largest H.264 size. Starts off. Asked for in #379 and #348.

- `Download any video` adds `Never save HDR video` under Downloads. An HDR-only video is saved at its largest standard size instead, so it skips the yellow or green cast some apps give HDR. Starts off. Reported in #352.

- `Seek bar on feed videos` is a new patch. A bar along the bottom of the video playing in your feed lets you drag to any point in it. The switch is under Feed and starts off. Asked for in #389.

- In `Glass tab bar`, `Blur strength` and `Tab bar opacity` under Tab bar are sliders (2 to 48 dp, 0 to 150 percent), and the pill follows as you drag. Both start at the old look. Older backups still restore. Asked for in #391.

- When Instagram crashes in the first minute after it opens, HushGram now keeps what crashed, and the diagnostics report you save from `HushGram settings` includes it. Turn on Debug logging to keep later crashes too.

- `Group Instagram's notifications` adds `Mute notification types` under Notifications. It stops the types you tick, like the betting and promo pushes Instagram's own notification settings can't turn off, and works with grouping off. Nothing's muted to start.

- `Lock your messages` adds `Fingerprint or face only` to Unlock with under Messages, on Android 11 and up. Its prompt has no PIN, pattern or password. Remove every fingerprint and face and your screen lock unlocks again.

- `Full screen Reels and Home` adds `Show the whole reel` under Reels. Every reel fits inside the screen with black bars where its shape differs, so nothing's cut off at the sides. Starts off.

- `Skip the collections tray` is a new patch. With its switch on under Feed, saving a post or reel shows Instagram's Saved message instead of the tray that asks you to start a collection. Starts off.

- `Hide the Reels tab` adds `Settings button on Home's header` under Tab bar. A gear at the top of Home opens HushGram settings with one tap. Starts off. Asked for in #404.

- `Download any story` adds `Download button on stories` under Stories. A button at the top of a story, beside the three dots, saves the photo or video in front with one tap. Starts off. Asked for in #400.

- `Start reels with sound` adds `Start reels muted` under Playback. Every reel starts silent, even from a link or a notification, and the volume keys or speaker icon unmute it. Starts off. Asked for in #342.

- `View live anonymously` adds `Mark as seen button on lives` under Stories. While you watch a live anonymously, an eye beside the three dots puts you on that live's viewer list when you tap it. Starts off. Asked for in #412.

- `Glass tab bar` adds `Bend light at the edges` under Tab bar. With `Liquid glass look` on, the pill's rim bends what passes under it the way real glass does, on Android 13 and up. Starts off. Asked for in #369.

- `Glass tab bar` adds `Run Reels behind the tab bar` under Tab bar. The reel fills the screen behind the pill, with its caption, buttons and seek bar just above it. Starts off. Asked for in #372.

- `Clean up Reels` adds `Hide suggested searches on reels`, `Hide shopping buttons on reels` and `Hide poll prompts on reels` under Reels. Each takes its prompt away from beside the reel's author. All three start off. Asked for in #332.

- `Start Home on Following` adds `Fall back to Following` under Feed. When For you brings an account only suggested posts, page after page, Home opens on Following for that account. A feed you pick stays picked. Starts off. Asked for in #308.

Fixes

- `Instagram logo on Home` works without `Start Home on Following` now. Turned on, the logo stays put as you scroll instead of switching to "Home" and flashing blank in between. Reported in #413.

- `Turn off HDR brightness boosts` also stops the brighter white Instagram 452 and later give some reels on phones with HDR headroom, like the Galaxy S25 FE. Reported in #85 and #26.

- `Full size covers` asks for covers up to 1440 pixels wide now. It used to stop at 1080, and some picked covers are 1290 wide. Reported in #214.

- Turning `Full size covers` on or off now reaches reels you'd already opened. Instagram keeps the cover sizes it was sent across restarts, so the first start after a change now drops those saved answers. Reported in #214.

- `Hide Featured in notifications` works on Instagram 453 again, Threads suggestions included. Featured rows were back at the top of Notifications. Reported in #259.

- With `Hide the Muse card`, the Meet Muse card stays off Home and your profile when Instagram sends it some other way. It still showed up now and then. Reported in #294.

- With `Pure black dark mode`, a story now opens straight on black. It flashed Instagram's dark blue for a moment first. Reported in #360.
